name: algo-akanade-react
description: A ready-made <AkanadeChatWidget> for any React website: chat, voice (mic button, shown only when the browser supports Web Speech), and inline chart rendering — drop it in with just a baseUrl and credentials. Built on algo-akanade-react-core's shared hook and algo-akanade-voice's browser adapter. Plain inline styles, no CSS framework dependency, so it doesn't fight an existing app's styling.
